info.title: Automation-Engine
info.description: Kafka topics and MQTT topics of the engine. Topic names are the defaults of the configuration; the environment variable that changes one is named in its channel. {placeholders} in addresses are channel parameters.

gateway-mqtt.description: MQTT_BROKER; the broker of a gateway, in fog mode, shared with the device connectors.

sync-mqtt.description: SYNC_MQTT_BROKER; the cloud broker that mgw-device-cloud-connector bridges to the brokers of the gateways.

networkId.description: id of the hub of the gateway

cloudApplied.description: Gateway to cloud; the replicas share the subscription SYNC_SHARE_GROUP.

networkId.description: id of the hub of the gateway

cloudChanges.description: Gateway to cloud; the replicas share the subscription SYNC_SHARE_GROUP.

id of the hub of the gateway
id of the hub of the gateway

replicaId.description: id of the replica that asked

cloudResponse.description: Answer of a gateway to a request; only the replica that asked subscribes.

networkId.description: id of the hub of the gateway

cloudStatus.description: Gateway to cloud; the replicas share the subscription SYNC_SHARE_GROUP.

networkId.description: id of the hub of the gateway

commandError.description: ERROR_TOPIC; failed commands, read in the consumer group KAFKA_CONSUMER_GROUP. Protocol handlers may also POST them to /errors of the internal port.

commandResponse.description: RESPONSE_TOPIC; answers of protocol handlers, read in the consumer group KAFKA_CONSUMER_GROUP. Protocol handlers may also POST them to /responses of the internal port.

serviceTopic.description: service id with ':' and '#' replaced by '_'

deviceData.description: Device data of the services that event descriptions of deployments name, read in the consumer group EVENT_CONSUMER_GROUP. The topic is the service id with ':' and '#' replaced by '_'.

deviceGroups.description: DEVICE_GROUP_TOPIC; a changed device group changes the event descriptions of deployments that select it (DEP-08) and clears its cache entry in every replica.

deviceTypes.description: CACHE_INVALIDATION_ALL_TOPICS; any message clears the device cache of every replica.

devices.description: DEVICE_TOPIC; clears the cache entry of the device in every replica.

gatewayApplied.description: Gateway to cloud, on the broker of the gateway.

gatewayChanges.description: Gateway to cloud, on the broker of the gateway.

gatewayDesired.description: Cloud to gateway, on the broker of the gateway.

gatewayRequest.description: Cloud to gateway, on the broker of the gateway.

gatewayResponse.description: Answer of a gateway to a request, on the broker of the gateway.

gatewayStatus.description: Gateway to cloud, on the broker of the gateway.

gatewayUpAck.description: Cloud to gateway, on the broker of the gateway.

importTopic.description: kafka_topic of the import instance in import-deploy

importData.description: Data of the imports that event descriptions of deployments name, read in the consumer group EVENT_CONSUMER_GROUP.

localCommand.description: Device commands to the device connectors of a gateway; command_id starts with LOCAL_COMMAND_PREFIX.

localError.description: A command a device connector could not deliver; the payload is the error text.

localEvent.description: Device data on a gateway; the payload is the data segment as the service describes it.

localResponse.description: Answers of device connectors; those whose command_id lacks LOCAL_COMMAND_PREFIX belong to another service and are ignored.

permissions.description: PERMISSIONS_KAFKA_TOPIC, not set by default; a RIGHTS message without the administrate right of the owner restores it (SEC-10).

protocolHandler.description: handler of the protocol of the device, e.g. connector

protocolCommand.description: Device commands to platform-connector. The topic is the handler of the protocol of the device; a handler that is an http(s) URL gets the message as POST instead. The key is the device id.

protocols.description: CACHE_INVALIDATION_ALL_TOPICS; any message clears the device cache of every replica.

users.description: USER_TOPIC; a DELETE removes the data of a user deleted outside of user-management (SEC-14).

receiveGatewayRequest.summary: ask the gateway, e.g. for the debug state of an instance

receiveGatewayUpAck.summary: acknowledge a batch of the change stream

sendCloudRequest.summary: ask the gateway, e.g. for the debug state of an instance

sendCloudUpAck.summary: acknowledge a batch of the change stream

import_id.description: id of the import instance; the further fields are the output of its import type
